symptom_short: A client connected to a non-leader quorum member issues a create-with-stat write; the request is never answered, the member's commit pipeline halts, and every client on that member is disconnected

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded (private/ source/ logs/ diagnosis/); PROGRESS.md + state.json created; bug claimed in COORDINATION.log.

JIRA ZOOKEEPER-1851 ('Follower and Observer Request Processors Do Not Forward create2 Requests', Blocker, affects+fixVersion 3.5.0, Resolved/Fixed). Fix commit = bcf09c846 (Rakesh Radhakrishnan, 2014-07-18, svn trunk@1611732). Its diff adds the missing 'case OpCode.create2:' to (1) FollowerRequestProcessor.run's forward-to-leader switch, (2) ObserverRequestProcessor.run's forward-to-leader switch, (3) CommitProcessor.needCommit(), and (4) TraceFormatter.op2String (log/trace only); it also adds test QuorumRequestPipelineTest + QuorumBase refactor. pre_fix_commit = 25ea38a87 (ZOOKEEPER-1968, last commit where the bug exists; verified its FollowerRequestProcessor switch has create/delete/setData/reconfig/setACL/multi/check but NOT create2). Confirmed the diff resolves the reported symptom: without the case, the follower queues the request into CommitProcessor but never ships it to the leader; needCommit()==false makes CommitProcessor treat it as a read and hand it to FinalRequestProcessor with request.getHdr()==null, where the isQuorum() branch calls ZKDatabase.addCommittedProposal -> request.getHdr().serialize() -> NPE outside the processor's try/catch; WorkerService then runs CommitWorkRequest.cleanup(), which halts the CommitProcessor, so the member answers nothing further and its clients are disconnected.

Built the pre-fix tree (25ea38a87, ZooKeeper 3.5.0-SNAPSHOT) from source with Ant+Ivy in per-bug image clods-eval:Zookeeper-Zookeeper-1851 (clods-eval + openjdk-8-jdk + ant; JDK11/17 refuse -source/-target<7). Build cmd: 'ant jar' -> build/zookeeper-3.5.0-SNAPSHOT.jar + build/classes + build/lib (slf4j 1.7.5, log4j 1.2.16, jline 2.11, netty 3.7.0.Final, jetty 6.1.26, jackson 1.9.11, commons-cli 1.2). Dep fixes (private/deps-fix.patch, 3 edits, no source changes): (1) build.xml ivy.url http://repo2.maven.org -> https://repo1.maven.org (repo2 host is gone and Central refuses plain HTTP); (2) build.xml javac.source/javac.target 1.5 -> 1.8 (javac 8 rejects source/target 1.5 pairing with its 1.8 default bootclasspath); (3) ivysettings.xml repo.maven.org/repo.jboss.org/repo.sun.org -> https://repo1.maven.org (jboss + download.java.net are dead). BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 10s.

Reproduced on the real system: a 3-node ZooKeeper 3.5.0-SNAPSHOT ensemble built from the pre-fix tree, all three members with root logger AND console appender at DEBUG, roles discovered with the servers' own 'srvr' 4lw (leader=21853/myid3, followers=21851/myid1 and 21852/myid2). Real traffic: two 120-iteration create/getData/setData/exists/getChildren/delete workloads (leader + follower2) through the public ZooKeeper client API, a real zkCli shell session on the leader (40x create/get/set/stat + 20 deletes), and a client pinned to follower myid1 doing ephemeral create/read/delete every 200ms for 45s. The failing session (also pinned to myid1) does a plain create (OK, 8ms) then one create-with-Stat: it never completes (ConnectionLoss after 6768ms), the node is never created, follower myid1 logs NPE at ZKDatabase.addCommittedProposal:251 <- FinalRequestProcessor:127 <- CommitProcessor$CommitWorkRequest.doWork:294, then 'Exception thrown by downstream processor, unable to continue.' + 'CommitProcessor exited loop!', after which that member answers nothing (collateral client: 20 ops OK then 5 straight ConnectionLoss). Detection is silent: assertions read the clients' result files and the servers' own logs and print only to reproduce.sh stdout. Workload.java writes nothing to stdout/stderr; NO log or print statement added to ZooKeeper anywhere. private/symptom.orig.log = 19037 lines (15615 DEBUG, 474 INFO, 18 WARN/ERROR) = 3 server logs + 6 client session logs, one '===== file: X =====' header each.

Minimal, case-targeted anonymization. Renamed exactly one distinctive term and its CamelCase forms: create2 -> createExt, Create2 -> CreateExt (covering Create2Request/Create2Response - which the Jute compiler generates from src/zookeeper.jute at build time, not tracked files - plus Create2Callback, Create2CB and the test method names). That is the token the JIRA title string-matches on. Everything else stays real: packages, all other class names, leader/follower/observer/quorum/znode/zxid terminology, every log message, version 3.5.0-SNAPSHOT. The ticket quotes no log or stack trace, so no JIRA-quoted-text redaction applies. The renamed tree was REBUILT ('ant jar', BUILD SUCCESSFUL) at the NEUTRAL path repos/zookeeper-quorum-src (the JVM prints user.dir + the classpath into the log, so the earlier zk-anon-Zookeeper-1851 path leaked the ticket number and was discarded) and reproduce.sh was re-run against it, so logs/symptom.log (19014 lines, 15618 DEBUG) is the genuine output of the renamed binaries, not a rewritten log; the failure still reproduces identically (create-with-stat ConnectionLoss after 6772ms, follower's CommitProcessor halted, node absent, collateral client 20 ok then 5 ConnectionLoss). Reproduction ports also moved 2185x -> 2455x so that no bare '1851' substring can occur in the log. source/ = the full renamed pre-fix Java tree (297 files: src/java/main + src/java/generated), not a hand-curated subset, so no file-selection hint is given to the LLM. Verified on the host: 0 hits for ZOOKEEPER-1851, 1851, create2/Create2/CREATE2 across source/ + logs/symptom.log.
